previous_statement: Because S_+ and S_- are subfamilies of the pairwise disjoint fibers in S and all positive-part summands are nonnegative, a^+(U_+) <= a^+(S) and b^+(U_-) <= b^+(S), where the right-hand quantities are exactly the fiber sums in the contract.
new_statement: Let n be finite, let a,b be real vectors indexed by {1,...,n}, and let S be a family of pairwise disjoint coordinate subsets. For d_Q := sum_{j in Q}(a_j-b_j), set S_+ := {Q in S : d_Q >= 0}, S_- := {Q in S : d_Q < 0}, U_+ := union_{Q in S_+} Q, and U_- := union_{Q in S_-} Q. Define r^+_coord(U) := sum_{j in U} max(r_j,0) for a coordinate set U and r^+_fib(T) := sum_{Q in T} sum_{j in Q} max(r_j,0) for a subfamily T of S. Then a^+_coord(U_+) <= a^+_fib(S) and b^+_coord(U_-) <= b^+_fib(S).
